pr.title: feat(sovd_adapter): expose diag_api::DataResource as opensovd_core::DataProvider
pr.body:
## Summary
- Implement `SovdDataProvider` adapter that implements `opensovd_core::DataProvider` backed by `diag_api::DataResource` instances
- Add `DataResourceRegistry` to manage resources with their metadata
- Replace demo Constant providers in opensovd-gateway with cruise control diag_api resources
- Add time-based debounce for fault qualification (mirrors DTC semantics)

## Components Added

### sovd_adapter crate
| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `lib.rs` | Public API: `SovdDataProvider`, `DataResourceRegistry`, `PayloadFormat` |
| `registry.rs` | Resource registration with metadata |
| `provider.rs` | `DataProvider` trait implementation |
| `convert.rs` | Type conversions between diag_api and opensovd_core |
| `handle.rs` | Async handle resolution (Ready/Pending) |

### opensovd-gateway changes
| File | Change |
|------|--------|
| `BUILD` | Add sovd_adapter and diag_api dependencies |
| `main.rs` | Wire cruise control resources instead of demo data |
| `cruise.rs` | Cruise control diagnostics with fault injection |

## Cruise Control Resources
| Resource | Category | Access | Description |
|----------|----------|--------|-------------|
| `vehicle_speed` | currentData | read | Vehicle speed sensor reading |
| `cruise_state` | currentData | read | Cruise control state (standby/active/unavailable) |
| `speed_sensor_fault_status` | currentData | read | Debounced fault status |
| `speed_sensor_stuck` | storedData | read/write | Fault injection control |

## Features
- `list()`/`categories()`/`groups()` derived from `DataResourceMetadata`
- `read(data_id, include_schema)` dispatches to `DataResource::read`, converts encoding
- `write(data_id, value)` dispatches to `DataResource::write`
- Error mapping: `diag_api::Error` / `DataError` to `opensovd_models::ErrorCode`
- Per-resource `PayloadFormat` (JSON, UTF8, Binary) for UDS adapters

## Test Evidence
- Unit tests in `sovd_adapter` crate
- Integration tests in `opensovd-gateway` using `opensovd-client`
- Cruise control debounce logic tests

Closes #16

Contributed by: EP1991 | Thinking_CAPs | Eclipse SDV Hackathon Chapter 4 2026

commit.message:
feat(diag_api): re-export JsonSchemaRequired

ReplyMessageEncoding::JSON takes a JsonSchemaRequired, which was not reachable
through the diag_api facade.

Refs #16

feat(sovd_adapter): serve diag_api DataResources as an opensovd DataProvider

DataResourceRegistry keeps each resource next to its metadata; SovdDataProvider
implements opensovd_core::DataProvider over it:

- list/categories/groups from DataResourceMetadata, with category/group/tag filters
- read/write await ReadValueHandle/WriteValueHandle (ready, future, closure)
- resources sit behind a Mutex (write takes &mut self); the lock is never held
  across an await
- per-resource PayloadFormat so the binary-only uds adapters are served as hex
  without extra code
- diag_api errors and NRCs map to DataError; read-only writes are rejected

Refs #16

feat(opensovd-gateway): serve cruise control diag_api resources instead of demo data

Replace the Constant demo providers with a cruise control example whose
vehicle_speed, cruise_state, speed_sensor_fault_status and speed_sensor_stuck
resources are served through the sovd_adapter. A time-based debounce
(Debounce::TimeBased semantics) turns an injected stuck sensor into a
qualified fault. Integration tests drive the running gateway through
opensovd-client.

Refs #16

+load("@rules_rust//rust:defs.bzl", "rust_library", "rust_test")
+
+# Serves diag_api::sovd::DataResource instances through opensovd_core::DataProvider,
+# so the OpenSOVD gateway can expose real S-CORE diagnostic data.
+rust_library(
+    name = "sovd_adapter",
+    srcs = [
+        "convert.rs",
+        "handle.rs",
+        "lib.rs",
+        "provider.rs",
+        "registry.rs",
+    ],
+    # diag_api and opensovd_core come from different crate universes, so each
+    # side has its own serde_json; the diag_api one is renamed to diag_json.
+    aliases = {
+        "@score_crate_index//:serde_json": "diag_json",
+    },
+    crate_root = "lib.rs",
+    edition = "2021",
+    proc_macro_deps = [
+        "@score_crate_index//:async-trait",
+    ],
+    visibility = ["//score:__subpackages__"],
+    deps = [
+        "//score/mw/diag/api",
+        "@opensovd_core//:opensovd-core",
+        "@opensovd_core//:serde_json",
+        "@score_crate_index//:indexmap",
+        "@score_crate_index//:serde_json",
+    ],
+)
+
+rust_test(
+    name = "sovd_adapter_test",
+    crate = ":sovd_adapter",
+    edition = "2021",
+    deps = [
+        "@score_crate_index//:tokio",
+    ],
+)

+// *******************************************************************************
+// Copyright (c) 2026 Contributors to the Eclipse Foundation

+// <https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0>
+//
+// SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+// *******************************************************************************
+
+//! Serves S-CORE [`diag_api::sovd::DataResource`]s through the OpenSOVD gateway.
+//!
+//! [`SovdDataProvider`] implements [`opensovd_core::DataProvider`] on top of a
+//! [`DataResourceRegistry`], so a gateway component can expose real diagnostic
+//! resources instead of demo constants:
+//!
+//! ```ignore
+//! let mut registry = DataResourceRegistry::new();
+//! registry.register(metadata, my_resource)?;
+//! let component = Component::new("hvac", "HVAC").with_data_provider(SovdDataProvider::new(registry));
+//! ```
+//!
+//! The adapter is in-process Rust, no FFI. Note that `diag_api` and
+//! `opensovd_providers` both define a trait called `DataResource`; this crate only
+//! uses the `diag_api` one.
+
+mod convert;
+mod handle;
+mod provider;
+mod registry;
+
+pub use provider::SovdDataProvider;
+pub use registry::{DataResourceRegistry, PayloadFormat, RegistrationError};

 # *******************************************************************************
 
-load("@rules_rust//rust:defs.bzl", "rust_binary")
+load("@rules_rust//rust:defs.bzl", "rust_binary", "rust_test")
+
+_SRCS = [
+    "src/cruise.rs",
+    "src/main.rs",
+]
+
+# tokio comes from opensovd_core's crate index so its TcpListener matches the one
+# opensovd_server expects; the diag_api serde_json is renamed to diag_json.
+_DEPS = [
+    "//score/mw/diag/api",
+    "//score/mw/diag/sovd_adapter",
+    "@opensovd_core//:opensovd-core",
+    "@opensovd_core//:opensovd-server",
+    "@opensovd_core//:tokio",
+    "@score_crate_index//:serde_json",
+]
+
+_ALIASES = {
+    "@score_crate_index//:serde_json": "diag_json",
+}
 
 rust_binary(
     name = "opensovd-gateway",
-    srcs = ["src/main.rs"],
+    srcs = _SRCS,
+    aliases = _ALIASES,
+    crate_root = "src/main.rs",
     edition = "2021",
     visibility = ["//visibility:public"],
-    deps = [
-        "@opensovd_core//:opensovd-core",
-        "@opensovd_core//:opensovd-models",
-        "@opensovd_core//:opensovd-providers",
-        "@opensovd_core//:opensovd-server",
-        "@opensovd_core//:tokio",
+    deps = _DEPS,
+)
+
+rust_test(
+    name = "opensovd-gateway_test",
+    srcs = _SRCS,
+    aliases = _ALIASES,
+    crate_root = "src/main.rs",
+    edition = "2021",
+    deps = _DEPS + [
+        "@opensovd_core//:opensovd-client",
+        "@opensovd_core//:serde_json",
     ],
 )
